questions.question: Expand 2x(3x − 5) and explain which law is used and why the answer has two terms.
questions.expected_answer: The distributive law: 2x multiplies each term, giving 6x² and −10x. The two products are unlike terms (x² and x), so they cannot be collected and the answer is 6x² − 10x.

questions.question: Why is 3x × 4x² equal to 12x³ and not 7x² or 12x²?
questions.expected_answer: Coefficients multiply: 3 × 4 = 12. Exponents of the same letter add: x¹ × x² = x³. Adding the coefficients (7) or forgetting to add exponents (x²) breaks one of the two rules.

questions.question: Expand −3a(a² − 2a + 4) and describe what happens to the signs.
questions.expected_answer: −3a³ + 6a² − 12a. Every term is multiplied by a negative, so every sign inside flips: plus becomes minus, minus becomes plus. Only flipping the first sign is the common error.
